name: LAION releases the CLAP2 audio dataset: over 1M hours and 365M clips from YouTube, CC and 300+ academic sets
title: LAION releases the CLAP2 audio dataset: over 1M hours and 365M clips from YouTube, CC and 300+ academic sets
summary: A Hugging Face engineer announced the LAION-Audio-XL dataset behind CLAP2, with more than a million hours of audio and 365M clips curated from web and academic collections, for training audio-language models.
